description: S1: network-wide demand surge x1.5 (+50%). Trapezoidal profile over 600-3600 s with 300 s linear ramps (full x1.5 from 900 to 3300 s), applied to every vehicle departing inside the window: extra clones of the same route with +-20 s jitter (id surge_<id>_<k>). Base vehicles untouched. 7200 s horizon: hour 2 is a jittered copy of hour 1 (as in hzreal_h2) so the network's recovery after the surge is observable. Control arm: hzreal_h2 at the same seed.
